name: Machir
bio: Machir son of Ammiel was a man of Lo-debar who had been sheltering Jonathan's crippled son Mephibosheth; David sent and brought Mephibosheth from his house to show him kindness for Jonathan's sake (2 Samuel 9:4-5). Machir later showed the same generosity to David himself, bringing supplies to him and his people when David fled Jerusalem during Absalom's rebellion (2 Samuel 17:27-29).
